edits.source: Bright Blue New Year Photo Frame.png
edits.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: the supplied 1536x1024 New Year photo frame. Create a production transparent PNG overlay. Make ONLY the large rounded rectangular photo window on the right, removing ALL printed checkerboard squares fully transparent edge-to-edge inside its frame. The whole photo aperture must be a clean alpha-zero cutout including close to its inner boundary, with crisp antialiased contours. Every pixel outside the photo aperture must remain opaque: retain original light backdrop, all artwork, the Happy New Year 2027 lettering, colors, decorations, size, exact composition, border curves and perspective unchanged. Do not invent, redraw, shift or crop any artwork. Do not replace the window with white, gray, black or a checkerboard: it must be genuinely transparent. Preserve the entire canvas.
